summary: VCCD recreation, fees and preserve pages + park map read; OSM and imagery used to find the campground. Fees $25 -> $20-25 (non-electric $20); 42 sites / 50 A confirmed; showers, dump, water, camp store from the page (showers and camp store new). Pin ~1.9 km off. Not waterfront re-confirmed at the real campground. Booking and season not stated.
flags: PIN: stored 39.99996,-87.55578 is the park entrance on County Road 900N (fields south of it), ~1.9 km SE of the campground. The park map puts '11. Family Campgrounds' by the Ranger Station, and OSM's 'Family Campgrounds' caravan_site centres at 40.01197,-87.57235, where imagery shows the gravel spur loops in woods. Move to 40.0120,-87.5723.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept, re-checked at the real campground (the stored evidence was read at the wrong pin, the entrance). The loops run along the NE side of Willow Creek Pond (7 acres; the district calls it a pond): the nearest spurs end ~22-35 m from the water but through continuous woods on the bank (leaf-off imagery, 40.0113,-87.5730 hw 110 m), and there is no pond-view value. A ~0.3 ha pond sits inside the loop, also wooded. No site numbers published.
